name: HIPHI rooster mascot animations
status: Design assets. Not wired into any page yet; which moments use the rooster is Nate's call (see README).

character.description: H4+ rooster: round orange body, big five-point comb, five-feather ocean-blue tail fan, head at 121% of the base size, full-size body. Faces right.

pivots_svg_units.comb_wobble: 50% 115% of the comb (rocks around the head centre so it never lifts off)

animations.title: Small win · head bob
animations.use: A small step done: saving or following a bill, picking a stance, an address found.
animations.trigger: Right after the action succeeds, next to the thing just done.
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster stands still; sparks hidden. Pair with fx.js tint() on the control.
animations.design_rules: Fits A-10 (small burst under 0.7 s) and C-7 (small win, small burst).

animations.title: Big win · hop and ta-da
animations.use: A big step: testimony submitted, the first action sent.
animations.trigger: After the submit succeeds; plays over the next screen once its slide has ended (A-10).
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster stands still; feathers, ring and petals hidden.
animations.design_rules: C-7 moment. A-10 caps a full-screen moment at 1.5 s and says any tap, key or scroll ends it: trim the last 0.1 s of feather drift and make it dismissable when wiring it in.

animations.title: Milestone · crow
animations.use: The biggest personal moment, e.g. the end of the first visit (the Mahalo page).
animations.trigger: When the Mahalo page (or another milestone page) arrives; the words sit under it.
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster stands still; beak closed; waves, feathers, ring and petals hidden.
animations.design_rules: Too long for a 1.5 s full-screen moment (A-10). Fits the Mahalo page pattern instead (a page that waits for Next, with its moment opening as it arrives, R-140/R-298).

animations.title: Bill passed · lei bloom
animations.use: A bill the person follows or acted on becomes law.
animations.trigger: When the person first sees that the bill passed.
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster stands still already wearing the lei; no sparkles.
animations.design_rules: C-7 names 'a bill becoming law' as a full-screen moment, capped at 1.5 s by A-10: either start it at the bloom (skip the hop, about 1.3 s) or show it on a page that waits for Next.

animations.title: Welcome · strut and wave
animations.use: First visit or onboarding: introduces the rooster.
animations.trigger: When the welcome screen opens; the welcome words sit beside it.
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster stands in place, no walk-in or wave.
animations.design_rules: Under the 5 s limit (A-10). Must not cover or delay the first visit's Next, and the first visit must still fit the window (R-265).

animations.title: Submitting · pecking loop
animations.use: While testimony or a form is sending.
animations.trigger: Start when the request is sent; remove when it finishes.
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster still; the three dots pulse slowly. Screen readers hear 'Sending your testimony' (role=status).
animations.design_rules: A-10: nothing moves by itself for more than 5 s. Stop the loop at 5 s and show the still rooster with words if the send is slow.

animations.title: Error · gentle head tilt
animations.use: Something failed (a send, a save). Sympathetic, never silly.
animations.trigger: With the error message; the message carries the meaning (A-10: motion never alone).
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster still with the concerned brow showing.
animations.design_rules: Fits A-10. Keep the error words and the retry button visible; the rooster is decoration.

animations.title: Empty state · peck and look up
animations.use: Empty lists: no bills saved yet, nothing due this week.
animations.trigger: When the empty state renders, next to its words and the action that fills it.
animations.design_rules: A-10: nothing moves by itself for more than 5 s. Play one 5 s cycle, then stop (animation-iteration-count: 1).

animations.title: Deadline reminder · ahem
animations.use: A gentle nudge: testimony due tomorrow, a hearing soon.
animations.trigger: When the reminder card or toast appears, beside its words.
animations.design_rules: Fits A-10. Never alarming; the reminder words carry the date.

animations.title: Streak · quick ta-da
animations.trigger: After the third action in a session.
animations.reduced_motion: Rooster still; the three sparkles show without moving.
animations.design_rules: CONFLICT with C-7 ('Never a streak counter, a badge, a score'). The three sparkles read as a count. Do not use without Nate's decision; if kept, use it as the session-end burst on Home (C-7) without the counting sparkles.

animations.title: Idle loop
animations.use: A resting rooster beside content (breathing, blinking, a head tilt, a tail flick).
animations.trigger: When a screen with the rooster settles.
animations.design_rules: CONFLICT with A-10 ('Nothing moves by itself for more than 5 seconds'). Use for at most 5 s after the screen opens, or only when the person taps the rooster.
